title: Lossy dielectric slab in WR-90 by the time-domain solver: εr = 2.2, tan δ = 0.05 matched at 10 GHz, 20 mm
source: TE10 transmission-line cascade with the complex propagation constant β = √(k0² ε(ω) − (π/a)²) in the slab (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §3.3 and §4.4) for the material the time domain realises, the conductivity σ = 2π·10 GHz·ε0·εr·tan δ: ε(ω) = εr − jσ/(ωε0) = 2.2 (1 − j 0.05·10 GHz/f); ABCD matrices evaluated separately from EMCraft's code

quantities.reason: finite integration on 1 mm cells, second order: measured 0.007, 0.015 and 0.021 dB at 8, 10 and 12 GHz (the magnitude converges at second order, `losses_converge_at_second_order`)

quantities.quantity: |S21| at 10 GHz (dB), where tan δ is matched

quantities.reason: the grid's phase error over the 40 mm guide (λg/30–λg/40 in the slab), second order as for the lossless high-pass filter: measured 1.1°
the slab's faces on grid planes; the reflections from its two faces add with the grid's phase error between them (measured 8.8e-3)
